power.title: 5 V input, protection and 3.3 V buck
power.notes:
Regulated 5 V +/-5%, 2 A, terminal 1 positive. USB VBUS is NOT a power input.
Check PCB thermal/current loops and external PSU before energizing.

processor_1.title: ESP32-S3FN8 / USB programming (1/2)
processor_1.notes:
Wired Ethernet only. Leave LNA_IN open and never initialize Wi-Fi/BLE.
GPIO26..32 used by internal quad flash: do not route. GPIO45 pulled low selects 3.3 V flash.

processor_2.notes:

ethernet_1.title: W5500 / HR911105A Ethernet (1/3)
ethernet_1.notes:

outputs_1.title: Output latches / counted timeout (1/2)
outputs_1.notes:
Default: ARM low, OE high, latches cleared before enabling. GPIO4/6/7 avoid boot UART pulls and GPIO1/2 glitches.
MC14541B: AR=1 disables automatic reset; MR pulled high until ARM. MODE=0, QSEL=1, A=B=1.
200k / 1nF C0G oscillator ~2174 Hz; 32768-count timeout ~15.07s. Release ARM immediately ends output.
ARM must be low >=10ms between commands. Hardware output requires both ARM and timer Q. No LED sensing.

outputs_2.title: Output latches / counted timeout (2/2)
outputs_2.notes:
Default: ARM low, OE high, latches cleared before enabling. GPIO4/6/7 avoid boot UART pulls and GPIO1/2 glitches.
MC14541B: AR=1 disables automatic reset; MR pulled high until ARM. MODE=0, QSEL=1, A=B=1.
200k / 1nF C0G oscillator ~2174 Hz; 32768-count timeout ~15.07s. Release ARM immediately ends output.
ARM must be low >=10ms between commands. Hardware output requires both ARM and timer Q. No LED sensing.

host01.title: Host 01: POWER / RESET only
host01.notes:
Two isolated normally-open contacts parallel the original case buttons.
No host LED sensing or isolated supply. Pin 9 remains this host reference for button ESD protection ONLY.
Do not join host references to controller ground or to one another. Pins 5..8 and 10 are NC.
Use verified motherboard signal names, not a universal F_PANEL physical pin map.

indicators.title: Controller power and output-enable indicators
indicators.notes:
PWR: 3V3 present. EN: OUT_OE_N low, output latches enabled.
Per-host red PWR/RST indicators follow the photorelay driver AND PHOTO_5V.
These indicate driver state, NOT actual contact closure or host power state.
RJ45 built-in LINK/ACT LEDs retained. All indicators use controller ground.

adapter.title: Passive POWER / RESET adapter
adapter.notes:
Build 10 copies; no active components or power supply.
POWER and RESET each pass through to original case switch with a parallel remote branch.
Original PLED/HDD cables stay directly on the motherboard and do not enter this adapter.
Pin 9: separately verified motherboard ground for button ESD. Pins 5..8 and 10 unused.
